AlphaExplore life, faith, and meaning.Registration is OpenFall Session

A place for your questionsWe believe everyone should have an opportunity to ask the big questions of life: What is my purpose? What happens when I die? Why is there suffering? Alpha sessions are a connection and conversation spanning the course of 12 weeks that explore those questions and more in a welcoming, judgement free environment. Alpha meets Wednesdays at 7 PM at the Cathedral, with virtual classes available on alternative evenings.Learn More
